statements.statement: CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring) was ordered
The patient has recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope
The symptoms are suggestive of sick sinus syndrome (I49.5)
The symptoms are suggestive of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9)
The diagnosis codes I49.5 and I49.9 were submitted
Continuous rhythm correlation over an extended monitoring period is required to capture and characterize the arrhythmic events
The denial reason code is CO-197
The CO-197 denial indicates that required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
